Best Local AI Models for RTX 3090 Ti (24GB)

The RTX 3090 Ti has 24GB of GDDR6X VRAM at 1,008 GB/s, the same bandwidth as the RTX 4090 and more than the RTX 3090 (936 GB/s). It holds dense models up to 33B at Q4 fully in VRAM: an 8B model runs at est. 124 tok/s, typical error 5% and a 32B model at est. 37 tok/s.

Last updated: November 9, 2026 · Editor: ModelFit Team

Compare with another device
Quick answer

The best local LLM for the RTX 3090 Ti is Qwen3.8 27B (est. 48 tok/s, typical error 5%) on its 24GB VRAM. It uses ~16.5GB of VRAM; the RTX 3090 Ti handles dense models up to ~33B at Q4. A 32B model at Q4 runs at est. 37 tok/s, typical error 5%. (ModelFit, 2026)

Sizing rule: a Q4 model needs about 0.6 GB of VRAM per billion parameters for its weights, and ModelFit budgets 90% of this card's 24GB (21.6GB) for weights, context, and KV-cache. Real files often load more than that rule, so the per-size table below checks actual builds: a size fits only when the lightest Q4 build of that size in our catalog loads within 21.6GB. MoE rows, and sizes with no such build, use a typical Q4 file size. Other strong fits: Gemma 4 26B-A4B (26B, ~16GB) and Gemma 4 12B (Q8) (12B, ~12.8GB). On this card Qwen3.8 27B runs at est. 48 tok/s, typical error 5%. What it will not run: a 35B MoE (3B active) model does not fit in VRAM alone, so it spills to system RAM over PCIe and slows sharply.

$ollama run qwen3.8:27b

ModelFit estimates, not measured benchmarks: decode speed of a generic Q4_K_M model of each size at 4K context on the RTX 3090 Ti's 1008 GB/s bandwidth. MoE rows scale by active parameters (decode reads only the active experts), so a 35B MoE runs far faster than a dense 32B. "CPU offload" sizes exceed the 24GB VRAM; dense models slow to a crawl there, MoE models degrade less because hot experts stay GPU-resident. Offload rows are rough estimates: no measured run covers offload, so they carry no typical error. What typical error means.

Fig. 2

Context costs VRAM too.

Qwen3.8 27B loads ~16.5 GB of weights; at 16k context the KV cache adds ~1.0 GB (still fits the ~22 GB usable VRAM), and at 64k it adds ~4.0 GB (still fits).

Weights 17 GBKV cache · 16k context 1.0 GBHeadroom 4.1 GBRuntime reserve 2.4 GB

The model leaves about 4.1 GB of the usable VRAM budget free after weights and 16k context.

KV-cache figures assume an fp16 cache, the llama.cpp/Ollama default. Standard GQA models use a size-class estimate (8 KV heads x 128 head dim class); hybrid linear-attention models (Qwen3.5/3.6, Qwen3-Next) use the exact per-token cost from their published config, since only their sparse full-attention layers cache KV. A q8_0 KV cache roughly halves either figure. Estimates, not measurements.

RTX 3090 Ti VRAM for AI: what actually fits?

ModelFit budgets about 21.6GB of the 24GB for weights and context. Qwen3.6 27B at Q4 (~18GB) loads with room for context, and 32B models at Q4 fit with a shorter one. Against the RTX 3090 the gain is bandwidth only, 6% on 8B models (est. 124 tok/s, typical error 5% vs est. 117 tok/s): both cards hold the same models. A 70B model does not fit one card and spills into system RAM.

RTX 3090 Ti FAQ: common questions

How much VRAM does the RTX 3090 Ti have?

The RTX 3090 Ti has 24GB of GDDR6X VRAM at 1,008 GB/s (NVIDIA Ada whitepaper). ModelFit budgets about 21.6GB of it for weights and context, enough for dense models up to 33B at Q4 quantization.

RTX 3090 Ti vs RTX 3090 for local LLMs?

Both have 24GB, so they load the same models. The Ti streams 1,008 GB/s against 936 GB/s, which makes it 6% faster on 8B models (est. 124 tok/s, typical error 5% vs est. 117 tok/s). Pick on price: the extra speed is small.

What size LLM can I run on an RTX 3090 Ti?

Dense models up to 33B at Q4 fully in VRAM, such as Qwen3.6 27B (~18GB) or a 32B model at est. 37 tok/s, typical error 5%. A 70B model at Q4 (~42GB) is too large for one card.

RTX 3090 Ti vs RTX 4090 for local AI?

Both have 24GB at 1,008 GB/s, so they hold the same models and decode at similar speeds (est. 124 tok/s, typical error 5% vs est. 133 tok/s on 8B). The 4090 has about twice the tensor throughput, so it reads long prompts faster.

How fast is a 27B-class model like Qwen3.8 27B on the RTX 3090 Ti?

ModelFit estimates a 32B model on the RTX 3090 Ti at Q4_K_M runs at est. 37 tok/s, typical error 5%. The current 27B-class pick in the catalog is Qwen3.8 27B (ollama run qwen3.8:27b).
